def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def dihnorm(cells):
    ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
    base=[(y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells]
    outs=[]
    for f in [(lambda y,x:(y,x)),(lambda y,x:(x,y)),(lambda y,x:(y,-x)),(lambda y,x:(x,-y)),
              (lambda y,x:(-y,x)),(lambda y,x:(-x,y)),(lambda y,x:(-y,-x)),(lambda y,x:(-x,-y))]:
        c=[f(y,x) for y,x in base]
        mys=min(y for y,x in c); mxs=min(x for y,x in c)
        outs.append(tuple(sorted((y-mys,x-mxs) for y,x in c)))
    return min(outs)

def feat_table(pn):
    a,ch,bg,singles,groups,ncomp,sings,rec=results[pn]
    tgt_not_in_group=[c for c in sings if not any(c==cc for g2 in groups for cc,_ in g2)]
    rows=[]
    for gi,g in enumerate(groups):
        members={frozenset(cl) for c,cl in g}
        for c,cl in g:
            others=[o for o in g if o is not (c,cl)]
            row=dict(pn=pn,gi=gi,color=c,size=len(cl),ncolor=ncomp[c],
                     cellscolor=sum(len(o[1]) for o in comps(a) if o[0]==c),
                     touch=any(y in(0,len(a)-1) or x in(0,len(a[0])-1) for y,x in cl),
                     singleton=(ncomp[c]==1),
                     dist_tgt=min((mind(a,cl,list(sings[s])) for s in tgt_not_in_group), default=None),
                     dist_members=min((mind(a,cl,o[1]) for o in others), default=None),
                     rep=frozenset(cl)==ch or (frozenset(cl)&ch and len(frozenset(cl)&ch)==len(ch)))
            rows.append(row)
    return rows

R=[]
for pn in (1,2,3,4): R+=feat_table(pn)
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(R)
pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print(df.to_string())

    """Canonical form of a cell set under rotation/reflection: the lexicographically smallest normalized tuple."""

        # rotate 90 degrees properly

    return best


def dup_groups(objs):
    """Group objects that share the same dihedral-normalized shape: list of lists of (color, cells)."""
    from collections import defaultdict
    d = defaultdict(list)
    for c, cells in objs:
        d[dihedral_norm(cells)].append((c, cells))
    return [v for v in d.values() if len(v) > 1]


def dmin_cells(a, b):
    """Minimum Manhattan distance between two cell sets."""
    return min(abs(y1 - y2) + abs(x1 - x2) for y1, x1 in a for y2, x2 in b)


def repaint_nested_dup(grid):
    """Recolor the farthest duplicate-shape twin of the object nested in the crook of the singleton L-container with the container's color."""
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs = all_objects(grid, bg)
    sings = {}
    for c, cells in objs:
        sings.setdefault(c, []).append(cells)
    sings = {c: v[0] for c, v in sings.items() if len(v) == 1}
